messages:
tara-support: heads up — customer 'acme-eu' reporting high p95 (~800ms) and intermittent 503s since ~08:42 UTC. They have dedicated eu-west capacity but our telemetry shows a spike of requests routed to hosted pools. Can someone take a look?

devon: looking. can you paste a sample request id / trace id?

tara-support: trace id trace-0a1b2c3d, req 8f7e6d. logs show auth accepted but router decision flagged 'no_capacity_pin' then fallback->hosted.

alek: checking routing logs... I see pin TTL refresh failed at 08:41:55 with 403 from pin-service: "pin-mismatch" for tenant acme-eu.

jen-sre: that 403 is suspicious — pin refresh should be using delegated-service-account. any infra deploys or key rotations around 08:39-08:42?

opsbot: deploy-bot: infra/routing-service v2.3.1 deployed at 08:39:57 :rocket: (canary)

devon: if pin refresh fails the router falls back to hosted. that explains latency and hosted billing. billing-ops: do you see charge spike for acme-eu?

billing-ops: confirmed: ~17k tokens to hosted in a 30m window, shows up as hosted billing. flagged for review, will hold credits pending support verification.

tara-support: customer is upset — they expected dedicated pricing and TTL pinned for 24h. they saw sudden hosted charges and higher latency simultaneously.

alek: quick grep in pin-service: owner fingerprint rotated at 08:39:45 (manual owner rotation event). pin-service returned invalidate-on-change, so refresh attempts failed until owner sync.

jen-sre: repro hypothesis: owner rotation causes short window where pin refresh returns 403 -> router marks pin stale -> fallback. can we repro in staging?

devon: reproducing in staging now. curl to staging router with headers Authorization: Bearer <short-lived> and X-Tenant: acme-eu returns 200 but response headers: X-Route-Pool: hosted, X-Pin-Status: expired_refresh.

tara-support: customer posted curl debug for their internal pin refresh: ```curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer abc' -H 'X-Tenant: acme-eu' https://pin-service.internal/pin/refresh``` response: 403 {"error":"pin-mismatch","detail":"owner-fingerprint-mismatch"}

alek: matches. root cause = manual owner rotation without pre-sync. remediation options: re-issue delegated credentials or rebind tenant to new fingerprint. also we can harden pin-service to allow a short grace window.

devon: immediate mitigation: increase router fallback grace TTL from 30s -> 120s so short rotation windows don't cause hosted bleed. I'll push a hotfix to canary.

jen-sre: +1 on metric: add hosted-fallback-rate per-tenant alert (threshold: 1% over 15m) so support is alerted before billing impact grows.

billing-ops: we'll hold off final crediting until mitigation confirms stopped bleed. queue provisional credit but require 2h confirmation window.

tara-support: relayed to customer; they accept temporary mitigation if it removes hosted traffic. asked for ETA for fix.

devon: rolling hotfix to staging now, aiming prod canary in ~15m. will update here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

opsbot: deploy-bot started canary deploy router v2.3.1+hotfix at 08:55:21

devon: canary looks good — staging repro no longer falls back during owner rotation testcase. monitoring shows p95 latency back to normal for acme-eu.

tara-support: customer confirmed improvement at 09:03 UTC, still waiting on billing reconciliation.

billing-ops: will assess credits if hosted token usage exceeds expected committed by >5% in the incident window. holding provisional entry.

alek: follow-up: file INF-4321 to add owner-rotation webhook to pin-service so router can prefetch new fingerprint and avoid expiry windows. also plan to add smoother degradation path in pin-service.

jen-sre: update runbook: support should check for owner-rotation events and escalate to infra when seeing pin-mismatch 403s. closing loop once INF-4321 PR merges and metric alert added. :white_check_mark:
